questions.question: You launched an email campaign and the delivery rate is 70%. Which step should you take first to troubleshoot?
options: Export bounce reasons from Campaign Analytics
Check segmentation filters for unengaged emails
Leverage Message Activity Log to identify hard bounces
questions.explanation: Exporting bounce reasons from Campaign Analytics helps identify why messages aren't being delivered and provides actionable data.

questions.question: Your users have different preferences when engaging with messages. What should you use to ensure delivery at optimal times?
questions.explanation: Intelligent Timing analyzes user behavior to determine the optimal time to send each user a message when they're most likely to engage.
